name: bge-small-v1.5-PatentClassification
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
license: not declared on card (base BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 is MIT)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Fine-tune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-dim, 512 max tokens) for patent classification. Same tensor set as the base. Recorded on the strength of a sentence-transformers evaluator print rather than a table: 'mteb/PatentClassification Validation accuracy' before {'accuracy': 0.2196} -> after {'accuracy': 0.5963}. It qualifies because before/after come from the same evaluator on the same split, so 'before' IS this repo's base, but the record is deliberately thin: one dataset, one metric, an auto-generated card with no training details, hyperparameters or baseline harness named, and accuracy on mteb/PatentClassification is not comparable to BEIR nDCG elsewhere in the catalog.

benchmarks.name: mteb/PatentClassification validation accuracy
benchmarks.config: Card prints a sentence-transformers evaluator dump, not a columned table: "before : {'accuracy': 0.2196}" -> "after : {'accuracy': 0.5963}" on mteb/PatentClassification validation. Same run, same evaluator, so the before number is this checkpoint's own base BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5. Reproducible only as an evaluator print, not a table row.
